thig5.7:1.1: agārasmiṃ vasantī 'haṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna bhikkhuno | addasaṃ virajaṃ dhammaṃ nibbānaṃ padam accutaṃ. || ||
thig5.7:2.1: sāhaṃ puttadhītarañ ca dhanadhaññañ ca chaḍḍiya | kese chedāpayitvāna pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ. || ||
thig5.7:3.1: sikkhamānā ahaṃ santiṃ bhāventī maggam añjasaṃ | pahāsiṃ rāgadosañ ca tadekaṭṭhe ca āsave. || ||
thig5.7:4.1: bhikkhunī upasampajja pubbajātim anussariṃ | dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ vimalaṃ sādhu bhāvitaṃ. || ||
thig5.7:5.1: saṅkhāre parato disvā hetujāte palokine | pahāsiṃ āsave sabbe sītibhūta mhi nibbutā. || || Sakulā. ||
